name: Buflomedil

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in France and 3 other countries, first in 2011 — for nerve and brain harm and blood vessel problems

summary: Buflomedil was pulled from the market in France and three other countries starting in 2011 because of issues with blood vessels and harm to the brain and nerves [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave it a low score of 30 for liver concerns and a medium score of 56 for heart concerns [M]. These computer-generated numbers and past market removals highlight the documented safety warning signs for the drug [3][M].
